verdicts.evidence: COULD NOT CLEAR — filed as a hole because no measurement decided it, not because one condemned it (the isRegularFile precedent). Survived the CI chunked unit pass, survived the whole-net pass (wholenet-verdicts.jsonl, 2026-09-03/04), and produced no observable difference — payload or rendered text — on any of the three probe missions. Residual variant beyond the pinned family tests; no probe mission or net leg reaches the mutated branch with distinguishing data. Probe suite (2026-09-04, committed recipe): three `init --example` missions — `nu` (untouched), `optin` (scaffold-lock structureContract:true), `declencheur` (optin plus an invalid `**Date**` header field in framing.md). For every mutant below, applied by exact offset into dist, `check --strict --json` AND the rendered `check --strict` text were compared byte-for-byte against the pristine build on all three. Re-measured 2026-11-12 (mutation-ratchet.yml run 43208428078, mode=measure, at e5ff5f2): Stryker reported it Killed only because test/unit/example-packed.test.js refused the tarball npm packed inside Stryker's sandbox (`tar -xzf`, members under package/../../node_modules), a failure independent of the mutant, while every other covering test passed; re-run alone on that test against a local build byte-identical to the measured source, it survives, so this filing stands.
